finalSummary:
The lore:agents block in CLAUDE.md is regenerated under lore 0.9.2, and CI now gates it (PR #247, OPAG-378 AC4). I verified the carve-out in the canonical block myself. The rewrite stayed within it: only lines 55-61, inside the markers at 53/62, changed. The lore skill is plugin-sourced, so no SKILL.md was written.

Local proof: lore agents --check exits 0 on a clean tree, 6 with one mutated byte in the block, and 0 after restore.

The lore check workflow pin moves 0.9.0 to 0.9.2, and the job gains a lore agents --check step. On the PR head bfab45f, lore check run 36082270442 installed lore 0.9.2, lore check reported 0 errors, and lore agents --check ran and passed. All three required contexts passed with no row pending.

Versions: lore 0.9.2 (global and CI), quest 0.9.0 global, held back deliberately until opum-cli-e2e TASK-106.
